title: The XZ Mods manual
summary: Every screen, control and setting XZ Mods adds to the XDJ-XZ. Pick your interface at the top and the manual shows only what applies to you.

chapters.title: Controls on the player
chapters.summary: Which buttons, pads and knobs do something new, and what each one does with XZ Mods running.

chapters.summary: Games, USB apps, reporting a problem and the About page.

chapters.title: Settings reference
chapters.summary: Every setting XZ Mods stores on the USB, its values, its default and where it is explained.

tour.title: MODERN interface
tour.text: XZ Mods can draw the whole play screen: bigger waveforms, a browse sidebar and stem buttons. CLASSIC keeps the player's own screen.

tour.title: Stems
tour.text: Mute vocals, harmonics and drums live from the pads or the screen. BYPASS brings back the whole track.

tour.title: Four decks
tour.text: Decks 3 and 4 play on mixer channels CH3 and CH4, over one short USB cable from the back of the player to the top.

tour.title: Beat jump
tour.text: Two pages of jump sizes you choose, from 1 beat to 64 bars, on all four decks.

tour.title: Keys and KEY SYNC
tour.text: Move a deck's key a semitone at a time, or match it to the master deck with SHIFT + SYNC.

tour.title: RAM tracks
tour.text: Copy a track into the player's memory, so the deck keeps playing if the music USB goes out.

tour.title: Themes and colours
tour.text: 25 themes, waveform colours, your own 3-band colours and key notation.

tour.title: The MODS menu
tour.text: Everything XZ Mods can change, in one menu on the player. Every change saves to your USB.

tour.title: DJ profile
tour.text: Your name and logo on the player, carried on your USB.

tour.title: This app
tour.text: Prepare the USB, make stems and watch the XZ screen live on your computer.
